EO:13783.where: sec. 7(a), first sentence ('Executive Order 13783 of March 28, 2017 (Promoting Energy Independence and Economic Growth) ... are hereby revoked'), 86 FR 7041
EO:13783.exception: none: the only sec. 7(a) exception ('except for sections 6, 7, and 11') attaches to EO 13834

EO:13807.where: sec. 7(b), first sentence ('Executive Order 13807 of August 15, 2017 ... is hereby revoked'), 86 FR 7042
EO:13807.exception: none; the second sentence of sec. 7(b) only directs OMB and CEQ to consider a replacement order

own_effect_interactions_read.quote: There is hereby established an Interagency Working Group on the Social Cost of Greenhouse Gases
own_effect_interactions_read.bearing: establishes a NEW Working Group the same day; it does not mention or reinstate the Working Group that EO 13783 sec. 5(b) disbanded or the six documents EO 13783 withdrew

own_effect_interactions_read.quote: Executive Order 13754 and the Presidential Memorandum of December 20, 2016, are hereby reinstated in their original form
own_effect_interactions_read.bearing: reinstates only those two instruments; EO 13653 and the other memoranda revoked by EO 13783 sec. 3(a) are not mentioned

own_effect_interactions_read.quote: shall promptly take steps to rescind any orders, rules, regulations, guidelines, or policies, or portions thereof ... implementing or enforcing the Executive Orders, Presidential Memoranda, and draft guidance identified in this section
own_effect_interactions_read.bearing: directs removal of implementing residue; it is not a savings clause

own_effect_interactions_read.quote: Nothing in this order shall be construed to impair or otherwise affect: (i) the authority granted by law to an executive department or agency, or the head thereof
own_effect_interactions_read.bearing: general non-impairment of statutory authority; saves no revoked order or act

effective_date_reading: EO 13990 states no effective date and has no delayed-effect wording in secs. 7(a)-(b); it was signed January 20, 2021 and printed 86 FR 7037 on January 25, 2021. The project takes an order with no effective wording to be effective on signing, so both revocations are dated 2021-01-20.
